newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR index extends gains.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR index extends gains.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.83 points, or 0.97 percent higher at 86.79 on Tuesday after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended provisionally 36.99 points higher at 3,767.19.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 16.97 percent.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
